literal: condemned things / having rejected / they shun not / to those who did / those things / themselves / even if accomplished / sorrow / will give
translation: Even if successfully accomplished, forbidden actions done by those who fail to shun them will only bring sorrow.
modern: விலக்கப்பட்ட தீய செயல்களை முழுமையாக விலக்காமல் செய்பவர்களுக்கு, அச்செயல்கள் வெற்றிகரமாக முடிந்தாலும் முடிவில் துன்பத்தையே தரும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against engaging in actions that are fundamentally wrong or forbidden. The phrase 'கடிந்த கடிந்து ஒரார்' refers to those who fail to reject and stay away from condemned deeds. Even if such impure actions seem to succeed and reach completion ('முடிந்தாலும்'), the actions themselves ('அவை தாம்') will ultimately yield only sorrow ('பீழை'). The emphasis is on the purity of action, showing that bad means cannot lead to truly good ends.
